subject.title: Fallback turns can re-execute work already reported as completed (semantic recursive task execution)

question: Should OpenClaw land the linked PR as a scoped embedded sessions_spawn mitigation while leaving this issue open for gateway loopback, sessions_send/cron, and Codex-native follow-ups, or hold for one shared work-spawning policy seam first?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but the permanent boundary crosses OpenClaw embedded tools, gateway/tool exposure, scheduling, and upstream Codex-native collaboration tools.

options.title: Accept Scoped Mitigation
options.body: Review and land the linked PR as an embedded-runtime guard, with this issue remaining open for the unguarded surfaces.

options.title: Harden All OpenClaw Surfaces First
options.body: Require the linked PR or a replacement to also handle gateway loopback sessions_spawn and sessions_send/cron scheduling before merge.

options.title: Pause For Codex Upstream Scope
options.body: Hold the OpenClaw change until maintainers decide whether Codex-native spawn_agent must be changed upstream in the same effort.

recommendation.title: Accept Scoped Mitigation
recommendation.body: Review and land the linked PR as an embedded-runtime guard, with this issue remaining open for the unguarded surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is assigned to the linked PR and authored the cross-harness scope review that this issue now depends on.
